scan_runs.notes: First real scored scan. Full descriptions read and scored per the stage gate for all 8 new postings. 3 shown as Apply/Consider; Aroundtown SA added to companies looked at after its Apply-tier match. 4 postings failed the scoring threshold or a hard constraint (mostly mandatory German/Mandarin fluency, one on score alone) and are excluded from the postings list entirely, per the framework's Skip rule — companies stay on record, individual postings don't. Two UK postings carry an unresolved work-authorization flag — not excluded, but not confirmed either. The 2 placeholder leads from the first connectivity test (Hilton, GBR Recruitment) had no real posting link — resolved to 'no confirmed listing found,' companies kept as watch targets.

scan_runs.type: Startup-prospects filtering pass (224 hidden EU companies)
boards_checked: Company career pages / ATS boards (join.com, Ashby, Workable, Stryve, sage.hr, LinkedIn, direct sites)
scan_runs.notes: First filtering pass over the 224 hidden EU startup prospects (5 parallel research agents checked career pages/job boards for a role matching Bij's target profile). Of 224: 12 had a candidate open role worth a full read. After the stage-gate full-posting read: 4 passed scoring and constraints and were promoted to postings + companies looked at (Saga 75, Lebesgue 85, Billys 90 — all Apply-high; Kinderpedia 70 — Apply standard). 4 were excluded on a hard constraint (syte: mandatory native German; Zynt: mandatory Polish C2; Conveo: requires strategy-consulting/BizOps background + US-citizen-only language; Oneleet: founding-level seniority and a practically SF-based remote-first role). 3 could not be fully verified even after checking the company's own site and are left unscored (Teneo Protocol: careers detail page 404s; Duna: Ashby board is JS-rendered and unreadable; Origin: sage.hr listing not fetchable) — these stay flagged for a manual check, not added to the tracker per the no-score-without-full-posting rule. 1 was a false match: "Bloop" in Portugal turned out to be a same-named but unrelated US/Philippines company — flagged as an identity mismatch, not added. The remaining ~212 prospects had no relevant open role at check time (hiring for unrelated roles, not currently hiring, or a dead/unreachable careers page) and stay in the hidden startup_prospects database with their checked status, so a future re-scan can skip straight to re-checking rather than re-researching from scratch.
